algorithm.dynamic: Two bank-read passes: pass1 reduce per-group BF16 absmax/P max without buffering full tensor; generate FP32_RNE(max/127), scale1 for allzero. Pass2 rereads same owned generation and quantizes each valid lane. Group order/layout exactly matches interpreter.
algorithm.static: Load valid positive finite B7 scales first; one BF16 source pass then byte output and scale sidecar.
algorithm.quantization: Exact promote BF16, FP32_RNE(x/scale), clip to [-127,127] or P[0,127], nearest-even integer rounding. Never substitute reciprocal multiplication. Finite quotient overflow saturates; invalid source/scale errors.
algorithm.division: Four pipelined restoring significand dividers, exact remainder supplies sticky bit; exponent/subnormal correction and RNE. Target four accepted lanes/cycle II1; exact latency and registers established in child cycle contract before dispatch.
algorithm.dequantization: Reuse frozen w8a8_fp32_pkg and w8a8_fp32_mul arithmetic implementation without altering children; four lanes, BF16 RNE with gradual underflow and signedzero.
